item.title: No REAL ID yet? You can still fly, but it may cost $45 without another form of accepted ID
item.description: Beginning Sunday, air travelers in the U.S. without a REAL ID or another acceptable form of identification, such as a passport, are subject to a new fee.

item.title: Video captures chaos inside 59-vehicle pileup on Highway 99 in Central California
item.description: A woman and her mother were injured after becoming trapped in the massive 59-car pileup on Highway 99 early Saturday morning while traveling from Oxnard to the Central Valley.

item.title: Texas stunner: Democrat Taylor Rehmet flips Republican state Senate district Trump won by 17 points
item.description: Republican Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick called it "a wake-up call for Republicans across Texas," where the GOP controls every statewide office.

item.title: 49ers hire ex-Atlanta Falcons coach Raheem Morris as defensive coordinator, sources tell ESPN
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers are hiring Raheem Morris as their new defensive coordinator, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Sunday.

item.title: Black History Month centennial channels angst over anti-DEI climate into education, free resources
item.description: In the 100th year since the nation's earliest observances of Black History Month, celebrations will go on. The current political climate has energized civil rights organizations, artists and academics to engage young people on a full telling of America's story.

item.title: Grammys 2026: See photos and fashion looks from music's biggest night
item.description: Take a look at all the red carpet looks as the stars kick off the 68th Grammy Awards.

item.title: Kennedy Center to close for 2 years for renovations in July, Pres. Trump says
item.description: President Donald Trump said Sunday he will move to close Washington's Kennedy Center performing arts venue for two years starting in July for construction.

item.description: Pushback against from music's biggest stars was visible Sunday from the Grammys red carpet and throughout the telecast, including a memorable speech from Bad Bunny.
